description: The questions in samples/questionnaire.pdf (Northwind Bank (fictional)); page 1 holds sections A and B, which are also the questions in samples/questionnaire-page1.png.

questions.text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all administrative and console access?
Do you have processes in place to make sure access (both physical and logical) is revoked when an employee, intern, vendor, contractor, or other associate leaves the company or a project?
Are user access rights reviewed periodically?
Is encryption and integrity protection in place for all internal network traffic that potentially carries sensitive information?
Are any storage buckets publicly accessible?
Do you monitor your network for security events?
Do you have a process for installing operating system and application updates and security patches on servers?
Do you regularly test your backups?
Does an independent third party regularly perform penetration tests on all systems used to provide services to customers?
Do employees complete security awareness training?
Do you inform affected customers about security incidents?
Is customer data stored in the EU only?
